name: navigation-readout-v1
feature_standardization: Perfeature training-episode mean and population std (ddof=0), floor1e-8. No calibration/test statistics enter fitting.
ridge_objective: min_W ||X_train_standardized W - (XY_train - mean_train_XY)||_F^2 + lambda ||W||_F^2. Intercept unpenalized, training means only; float64 normal-equation solve. No XY-label standardization.
calibration_selection: Minimum calibration Euclidean RMSE sqrt(mean(dx^2+dy^2)); exact ties choose smaller lambda. Fit only training episodes; do not refit on calibration. Lock selection before one held-test evaluation.
metrics: For selected readout, report Euclidean RMSE, mean, median,p90,p95,max and peraxis RMSE by split and episode. Every original cached frame gets a prediction and its original episode/step/globalrow/pixelSHA identity.
information: Only frozen memory episodes128..175 and their previously cached192D observation embeddings/native XY labels. No controller development1000..1127, selection2000..2127 or final5000..5255 labels/pixels/embeddings are read. No controller outcomes are used.
interpretation: Root-cause qualification of a common learned visual-goal readout. It can motivate a separately frozen controller proposal if held memoryepisode testp90 is below12px, relative to16px tasksuccess. It is not an evolutionary result, online privileged goalXY input, controller completion result or accuracy guarantee on development/final query scenes.
stopping: One fixed grid, one calibration choice and one held memoryepisode test evaluation. Retain negative results and all artifacts; no grid/split/testcase revision or new controller episodes inside this stage.
